children: Japanese stocks may remain rangebound as caution grows over the Fed's rate increases following hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data overnight. Nikkei futures are down 0.1% at 60270 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.74 yen, compared with Y158.04 as of Tuesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on domestic earnings as well as crude oil prices. Nissan Motor is scheduled to report its quarterly results later on Wednesday. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 2.9% to 60459.58 on Tuesday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
